product_one_liner.value: Qubrid provides on-demand GPU cloud infrastructure and a unified API for open-model inference to developers, researchers, and enterprises.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes GPU-as-a-Service and one API for open-model inference, serving developers, researchers, and enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists model prices.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear in the company's customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: Revelio Labs reports 42 employees worldwide as of June 2026, which falls in the 21-50 band; an earlier PitchBook count differs.

hq_location.notes: The official contact page gives the headquarters address in McLean, Virginia, United States.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook identifies Qubrid AI as founded in 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The first-party blog index is promotional/product-use content; the separate archive is largely model guides and comparisons. The inspected indexes do not establish two posts by engineers explaining how Qubrid's own product is built.

public_docs.notes: Qubrid has a public documentation portal with multiple sections and detailed model and inference documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists a Full Stack AI Engineer opening and links to its posting.

model_provider.value: Qubrid publicly offers models from multiple providers, including Qwen/Alibaba and Z.ai; it does not identify one exclusive model provider.
model_provider.notes: The public serverless catalog identifies provider names for its models.

compliance_certs.notes: Qubrid names SOC 2 and HIPAA in claims about compliant data centers and separately states SOC 2 compliance; these are the named items only.

last_funding.notes: Private Market View's November 6, 2026 funding record says Qubrid raised a $25 million Seed in September 2026; PitchBook labels a $25 million Seed as upcoming, so completion status is inconsistent across databases.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2026 Seed round reported by Private Market View falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026; PitchBook differs on whether the round is completed or upcoming.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer and Full Stack AI Engineer, but no SDR, BDR, sales representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: An October 7, 2026 announcement reports a major update to GPU Cloud Platform V3, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster names the founder/CEO and CTO; Ujjwal Rajbhandari's profile shows his Qubrid role began in 2024 and ended in August 2025, before the 12-month window, with no in-window executive change found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Qubrid AI marketing job posting names CRM (HubSpot/Zoho); it does not distinguish which alternative is actually deployed.
